entry.title: Class, Object, Instance
entry.summary:
Class
A blueprint or template for creating objects A collection of related variables and methods An entity to be implemented in the software An instance created exactly as defined by the class It is also called an instance of a class. The term "object" has a broader meaning that represents all instances. From an OOP perspective, it is called an "object" when declared with a class type. A concrete entity implemented in the software world based on a blueprint. In other words, when an object is materialized in software, it is called an "instance." The materialized instance is allocated in memory.
Feature An instance can be considered a subset of an object. From an OOP perspective, when an object is allocated in memory and actually used, it is called an instance. The term is used when focusing on the relationship between an abstract concept (or specification) and a concrete object.
